title: Query-to-evidence packet contract with lexical and graph retrieval v0
problem: Blocked by reviewed GO on ticket-422. The engine has graph and synthesis components but no operational user-query retrieval path. The first RAG ticket must retrieve only accepted, scope-compatible evidence into a bounded citation-ready packet before adding embeddings or answer generation.
acceptance_criteria: A private CLI accepts a question plus research contract/domain and returns a bounded evidence packet without generating an answer.
Deterministic lexical retrieval uses SQLite FTS5 or an equivalent local index over accepted claim text and public-safe metadata, then expands through valid graph evidence.
Scope, domain, section eligibility, lifecycle state, source quality, and source-family filters are applied before ranking.
Every packet item includes stable claim, quote, source, section, relationship or atom identifiers sufficient for citation resolution; raw private text outside bounded evidence is excluded.
Rejected and needs-review claims cannot appear even when their text is a stronger lexical match.
Retrieval is deterministic, idempotent, bounded by explicit top-k and token or character budgets, and records ranking reasons.
On completion, ticket-424 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_research_retriever.py tests/unit/test_evidence_packet_contract.py tests/unit/test_claim_graph_consumer_isolation.py -q
With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not generate answers in this ticket.
Do not add embeddings or external vector databases.
Do not expose a public query or write route.
Do not retrieve rejected, staged, or private review notes.
rollback_plan: Remove the private retrieval command and stop maintaining the lexical index. Accepted graph data and existing synthesis contracts remain unchanged.
